claims.text: Namespaces isolate groups of resources within a single cluster; names of resources must be unique within a namespace but not across namespaces.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Concepts > Overview > Working with Objects > Namespaces

claims.text: kubectl uses the namespace of the current kubeconfig context when -n/--namespace is not given, and default when the context sets none; the kind-donhang context sets no namespace.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Namespaces (Setting the namespace preference); executed kubectl config view --minify

claims.text: Kubernetes starts with initial namespaces default, kube-node-lease, kube-public and kube-system; kube-system holds objects created by the Kubernetes system. A kind cluster also has local-path-storage.
Nodes and namespaces themselves are not in any namespace (cluster-scoped); kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false lists them; -n has no effect on kubectl get nodes.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Namespaces (Not all objects are in a namespace); executed kubectl get nodes -n donhang

claims.text: Namespaces cannot be nested inside one another.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Namespaces ('Namespaces cannot be nested inside one another')

claims.text: A namespace does not by itself restrict network traffic between Pods in different namespaces (that needs NetworkPolicy) nor limit who may change objects (that needs authorization rules such as RBAC).
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Network Policies (Pods are non-isolated by default); Namespaces; RBAC

claims.text: Pods from all namespaces are scheduled on the same nodes; a namespace has no nodes of its own.

deploy/k8s/namespace.yaml@stage-2 declares Namespace donhang; Đơn Hàng's own manifests under deploy/k8s/ (api.yaml, db.yaml...) set metadata.namespace donhang; lessons/web-pod.yaml sets none (its comment), so web goes to default.
Deleting a namespace deletes all objects in it.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Namespaces / Share a Cluster with Namespaces (Deleting a namespace)

claims.text: scripts/k8s/namespaces.sh@stage-2 applies web-pod.yaml, deletes namespace donhang (--ignore-not-found), then shows kubectl get pods, apply namespace.yaml (namespace/donhang created), get namespaces, and kubectl get pod web -n donhang -> Error from server (NotFound): pods "web" not found.

kubectl get pods -A (--all-namespaces) lists Pods of all namespaces with a NAMESPACE column; in a new kind cluster kube-system holds 12 Pods incl. etcd-donhang-control-plane and kube-apiserver-donhang-control-plane.
claims.source_hint: kubectl get reference (-A); executed kubectl get pods -n kube-system on donhang cluster

claims.text: In the kind cluster (kindnet, no network policy), a Pod in default can reach a Pod in donhang by its Pod IP.
claims.source_hint: kubernetes.io: Cluster networking model (all Pods can communicate with all other Pods); kind kindnet
